# Backpacker

> > America's leading resource for backpacking and wilderness hiking, featuring trail guides, gear reviews, and backcountry skills from the Appalachian Trail to the Pacific Crest Trail.

Backpacker Magazine provides comprehensive coverage of hiking, camping, and outdoor adventure with expert gear testing, trail recommendations, and skills education. The site features contributions from experienced writers like Emma Veidt, Maggie Slepian, Adam Roy, and Liz "Snorkel" Thomas, covering everything from thru-hiking preparation to backcountry cooking techniques.

## Key Topics

- Thru-hiking
- Backpacking gear reviews
- Appalachian Trail
- Pacific Crest Trail
- Long-distance hiking
- Summer Gear Guide
- Outdoor cooking and camp meals
- National Trails Day
- Winter camping
- Hiking skills and techniques
- National parks
- Ultralight backpacking
- Search and rescue
- Bear safety
- Trail stories and culture

## Essential Resources

- [Backpacker Magazine | Camping - Hiking - Gear - Skills](https://www.backpacker.com): Homepage featuring trail guides, gear reviews, and backpacking skills
- [The 2025 Summer Gear Guide](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/2025-summer-gear-guide): 2025 summer gear reviews including Osprey packs and ultralight equipment
- [The 2024 Summer Gear Guide](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/2024-summer-gear-guide): Comprehensive reviews of 500+ tested tents, packs, and hiking gear
- [Deals on Hiking and Backpacking Gear](https://www.backpacker.com/deals): Aggregated deals on hiking boots, tents, and outdoor gear from retailers

## Skills and Techniques

- [Thru-Hiking for Beginners](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/thru-hiking-for-beginners): Beginner's guide to long-distance hiking preparation and training
- [Hike All Winter Long](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/winter-camping-hiking-skills-gear): Winter camping guide with cold-weather backpacking skills and gear
- [The New Guide to Outdoor Cooking](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/the-new-guide-to-outdoor-cooking): Backcountry cooking guide with recipes and camp meal techniques
- [The Better Project](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/the-better-project): Trail techniques and skills for upgrading your backpacking experience

## Trail Stories and Culture

- [Bear Month 2025](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/bear-month-2025): Bear safety stories and survival advice with Tooth and Claw podcast
- [The Best Hiking Search and Rescue Stories](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/the-best-hiking-search-and-rescue-stories): Search and rescue stories and hiking safety insights
- [How the Trail Changes Our Relationships](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/how-the-trail-changes-our-relationships): Stories about hiking's impact on friendships and relationships
- [Endless Adventure](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/endless-adventure): Adventure stories and essays from dayhikes to epic expeditions

## Events and Celebrations

- [National Trails Day 2025](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/national-trails-day-2025): National Trails Day celebration with hiking trips and volunteering tips
- [Celebrate National Trails Day with These Perfect Hikes](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/celebrating-national-trails-day): National Trails Day hiking recommendations across the country

## Optional

- [The Ultimate Backcountry BBQ](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/the-ultimate-backcountry-bbq): Backcountry BBQ recipes and campfire cooking guides
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.backpacker.com/sitemap.html): XML sitemap for site navigation and SEO
